_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb16kJs771K7h4Eo3k1e7vmq)_

Fixes #31452

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:ADR-0011 身份动作清点里"另有 1 个未评估身份动作"改为 2 个,并在「Not assessed」段同时点名 `sys_user.list_platform_admins` 与新增的 `sys_sso_provider.edit_sso_sign_in_options`(PR #31448)。
- 为什么改:PR #31448 落地后,SSO 登录选项动作上线且未带 `ai` 块,ADR 仍写"唯一一个",清点与代码不符。
- 风险与回滚:仅改 ADR 文字两处,不动代码、不评估新动作;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md` 第 372–373 行与第 379–383 行。
- 两分钟验证:`grep -n "two more identity\|edit_sso_sign_in_options" docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md`,应见清点句写 two,「Not assessed」段列出两个动作。
- 需要你做的:作为受管审批人审阅并批准此 draft PR(`docs/adr/**` 属 Tier H)。

## What changes

- `docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md`, 2026-10-30 addendum: the census line now says the tree holds **two** more identity actions, unassessed, and the "Not assessed" paragraph names both — `sys_user.list_platform_admins` (PR #29427, 2026-11-02) and `sys_sso_provider.edit_sso_sign_in_options` (PR #31448, 2026-11-08) — as human-only, with no `ai` block, until a ruling assesses them.
- No assessment of the new action (that is a maintainer ruling). No code change. The H/C/E buckets and the "37 `ai` blocks" count are unchanged and still match the tree.

## Tests

Recount from the tree (main `158cc2aa` plus this branch), by importing `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/index.ts` and walking every exported object's `actions`:

- 63 identity actions in the tree, 37 with an `ai` block, 26 without.
- The 61 names in the H/C/E buckets all exist in the tree; the tree holds exactly two names in no bucket: `sys_sso_provider.edit_sso_sign_in_options` and `sys_user.list_platform_admins`, both without an `ai` block. No third unassessed identity action.

## Acceptance notes

- docs-only, publishes nothing: `skip-changeset`.
